basic_info.description:
$1700 + utilities (~$150) per month:
Quiet and Spacious Studio in SF near SFSU, Stonestown, CCSF.

Conveniently located on Byxbee Street with the following amenities:
 Closet space inside and outside unit,
 Cooking area with refrigerator and electric cooktop,
 Modern bathroom,
 On-site laundry facilities.

Newly-painted room walls, laminated wood flooring, with lots of natural light.
350 sq ft Studio on 1st floor of a House: comfortably fits up to 2 people.

Walking distance to SFSU, Stonestown, Whole Foods, Muni Metro M-line, and 28 and 29 Muni bus stops.
Short drive to Whole Foods, Philz, CCSF, and start of the freeway.

No smoking and no pets. Must do a background check and credit check if still interested after touring.

Message now to schedule an appointment!

Minimum 3-month lease that defaults to month-to-month after 3 months.
Deposit is 1 month of rent.
